pairs.en: Revenue-- $90.0 billion in the fourth quarter, an 18% increase driven by strong demand across the Azure platform and first-party AI applications.
pairs.zh:
营收——第四季度为$90.0 billion，同比增长18%，主要得益于Azure平台及第一方AI应用的强劲需求。

Revenue-- $90.0 billion in the fourth quarter, an 18% increase driven by strong demand across the Azure platform and first-party AI applications.

pairs.en: Non-GAAP EPS-- $4.74, a 23% increase when adjusted for the impact of investments in OpenAI.
pairs.zh:
非GAAP每股收益-- $4.74，在调整对OpenAI投资的影响后，增长23%。

Non-GAAP EPS-- $4.74, a 23% increase when adjusted for the impact of investments in OpenAI.

pairs.en: Azure and Other Cloud Services Revenue-- Grew 43% year over year, with customer demand continuing to exceed available capacity.
pairs.zh:
Azure及其他云服务营收——同比增长43%，客户需求持续超过可用产能。

Azure and Other Cloud Services Revenue-- Grew 43% year over year, with customer demand continuing to exceed available capacity.

pairs.en: Microsoft Cloud Revenue-- $59.3 billion for the quarter, growing 27% and surpassing $214 billion for the full fiscal year.
pairs.zh:
微软云营收——本季度 $59.3 billion，同比增长 27%，全财年突破 $214 billion。

---

Microsoft Cloud Revenue-- $59.3 billion for the quarter, growing 27% and surpassing $214 billion for the full fiscal year.

pairs.en: Commercial Remaining Performance Obligation (RPO)-- $678 billion, representing 84% year-over-year growth reflecting long-term customer commitments.
pairs.zh:
商业剩余履约义务（RPO）——6780亿美元，同比增长84%，反映出客户的长期承诺。

Commercial Remaining Performance Obligation (RPO)-- $678 billion, representing 84% year-over-year growth reflecting long-term customer commitments.

pairs.en: Microsoft 365 Copilot Seats-- Over 30 million paid seats, with net seat adds more than doubling sequentially.
pairs.zh:
Microsoft 365 Copilot 席位——付费席位超过3,000万，净增席位环比翻倍多。

Microsoft 365 Copilot Seats-- Over 30 million paid seats, with net seat adds more than doubling sequentially.

pairs.en: GitHub Copilot Revenue-- Accelerated over 60% quarter over quarter following a business model shift to usage-based pricing in June.
pairs.zh:
GitHub Copilot 营收——在6月商业模式转向基于使用量的定价后，环比加速增长超过60%。

GitHub Copilot Revenue-- Accelerated over 60% quarter over quarter following a business model shift to usage-based pricing in June.

pairs.en: Fabric and Foundry Adoption-- Paid Fabric customers reached 40,000, while Foundry customers grew to 100,000 with revenue more than doubling year over year.
pairs.zh:
Fabric和Foundry采用情况——付费Fabric客户达到40,000，而Foundry客户增长至100,000，营收同比增长超过一倍。

Fabric and Foundry Adoption-- Paid Fabric customers reached 40,000, while Foundry customers grew to 100,000 with revenue more than doubling year over year.

pairs.en: Agent 365 Scale-- Nearly 40 million agents registered across tens of thousands of companies within two months of launch.
pairs.zh:
Agent 365 规模——发布后两个月内，已有近4,000万个代理在数万家公司的生态系统中完成注册。

Agent 365 Scale-- Nearly 40 million agents registered across tens of thousands of companies within two months of launch.

pairs.en: Capital Expenditures-- $41 billion in the fourth quarter, reflecting investments in AI infrastructure and data center sites.
pairs.zh:
资本支出——第四季度$41 billion，反映了对AI基础设施和数据中心站点的投资。

Capital Expenditures-- $41 billion in the fourth quarter, reflecting investments in AI infrastructure and data center sites.

pairs.en: Data Center Capacity-- Added 31 data centers in the fourth quarter and 1 gigawatt of capacity, on track to double overall capacity in two years.
pairs.zh:
数据中心容量——第四季度新增了31个数据中心和1吉瓦的容量，按计划将在两年内将整体容量翻倍。

Data Center Capacity-- Added 31 data centers in the fourth quarter and 1 gigawatt of capacity, on track to double overall capacity in two years.

pairs.en: Maia 200 Performance-- Delivers 30% better performance per dollar compared to existing hardware and is currently scaling to support OpenAI and MAI models.
pairs.zh:
Maia 200性能-- 与现有硬件相比，每美元性能提升30%，目前正在扩展以支持OpenAI和MAI模型。

Maia 200 Performance-- Delivers 30% better performance per dollar compared to existing hardware and is currently scaling to support OpenAI and MAI models.

pairs.en: Productivity and Business Processes Revenue-- $37.8 billion, a 14% increase driven by Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud momentum.
pairs.zh:
生产力与业务流程营收——378亿美元，增长14%，由Microsoft 365 Commercial云业务增长势头驱动。

Productivity and Business Processes Revenue-- $37.8 billion, a 14% increase driven by Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud momentum.

pairs.en: Intelligent Cloud Revenue-- $39.3 billion, growing 32% primarily due to Azure and GitHub Copilot consumption.
pairs.zh:
智能云营收-- 393亿美元，增长32%，主要得益于 Azure 和 GitHub Copilot 使用量的增长。

Intelligent Cloud Revenue-- $39.3 billion, growing 32% primarily due to Azure and GitHub Copilot consumption.

pairs.en: More Personal Computing Revenue-- $12.9 billion, a 4% decline as Windows OEM and Xbox performance offset search advertising gains.
pairs.zh:
更多个人计算业务营收为 129 亿美元，同比下降 4%，原因是 Windows OEM 和 Xbox 业务表现抵消了搜索广告的增长。

More Personal Computing Revenue-- $12.9 billion, a 4% decline as Windows OEM and Xbox performance offset search advertising gains.

pairs.en: Shareholder Returns-- $10.2 billion returned through dividends and share repurchases in the fourth quarter, totaling $43 billion for the full fiscal year.
pairs.zh:
股东回报——第四季度通过股息和股票回购返还102亿美元，整个财年共计430亿美元。

Shareholder Returns-- $10.2 billion returned through dividends and share repurchases in the fourth quarter, totaling $43 billion for the full fiscal year.

pairs.en: Q1 2027 Revenue Guidance-- Expected to be between $89.85 billion to $90.95 billion, representing 16% to 17% growth.
pairs.zh:
2027财年第一季度营收指引——预计在$89.85 billion至$90.95 billion之间，代表16%至17%的增长。

Q1 2027 Revenue Guidance-- Expected to be between $89.85 billion to $90.95 billion, representing 16% to 17% growth.

pairs.en: FY 2027 Capital Expenditure Outlook-- Estimated at $175 billion, impacted by the shift from finance to operating leases for data centers.
pairs.zh:
FY 2027资本支出展望——预计为1,750亿美元，受数据中心从融资租赁转向经营租赁所影响。

FY 2027 Capital Expenditure Outlook-- Estimated at $175 billion, impacted by the shift from finance to operating leases for data centers.

pairs.en: Useful Life Extension-- Extended estimated useful life of data centers and office buildings from 15 to 25 years starting in fiscal year 2027.
pairs.zh:
使用年限延长——自2027财年起，将数据中心和办公楼的预计使用年限从15年延长至25年。

Useful Life Extension-- Extended estimated useful life of data centers and office buildings from 15 to 25 years starting in fiscal year 2027.

pairs.en: Investment Gains-- Included a $3.2 billion gain from an investment in Anthropic during the fourth quarter.
pairs.zh:
投资收益-- 包括第四季度对Anthropic投资带来的32亿美元收益。

Investment Gains-- Included a $3.2 billion gain from an investment in Anthropic during the fourth quarter.

pairs.en: Windows OEM and Devices Revenue-- Decreased 7% due to lower PC market demand and elevated inventory levels among partners.
pairs.zh:
Windows OEM和设备营收——由于PC市场需求下降以及合作伙伴库存水平较高，营收下降了7%。

Windows OEM and Devices Revenue-- Decreased 7% due to lower PC market demand and elevated inventory levels among partners.

pairs.en: Xbox Content and Services Revenue-- Decreased 10% against a high prior-year comparable, with a return to growth projected for fiscal year 2027.
pairs.zh:
Xbox内容与服务营收——同比下降10%，主要受去年同期高基数影响，预计将于2027财年恢复增长。

Xbox Content and Services Revenue-- Decreased 10% against a high prior-year comparable, with a return to growth projected for fiscal year 2027.

pairs.en: Healthcare AI Automation-- On pace to automate over 100 million patient encounters this calendar year, with 28 million automated in the fourth quarter.
pairs.zh:
医疗AI自动化--有望在本自然年内实现超过1亿次患者交互的自动化，其中第四季度完成了2800万次自动化。

Healthcare AI Automation-- On pace to automate over 100 million patient encounters this calendar year, with 28 million automated in the fourth quarter.

pairs.en: PostgreSQL Revenue-- Grew 55% for the third consecutive quarter of acceleration, driven by AI workload demand.
pairs.zh:
PostgreSQL 营收——增长55%，实现连续第三个季度加速增长，主要受AI工作负载需求驱动。

PostgreSQL Revenue-- Grew 55% for the third consecutive quarter of acceleration, driven by AI workload demand.

pairs.en: LinkedIn Engagement-- Revenue increased 12% with double-digit member growth for the fifth consecutive year.
pairs.zh:
LinkedIn 参与度业务——营收增长 12%，会员数量实现两位数增长，这已是连续第五年保持此增长态势。

LinkedIn Engagement-- Revenue increased 12% with double-digit member growth for the fifth consecutive year.

pairs.en: CFO Hood stated, "Growth in Windows OEM and Devices will be impacted by lower PC market demand as higher component cost increased device pricing," highlighting potential headwinds for the More Personal Computing segment in the coming fiscal year.
pairs.zh:
首席财务官Hood指出："Windows OEM与设备业务的增长将受到PC市场需求下降的影响，因为组件成本的上涨推高了设备价格，"并强调了在下一财年更多个人计算业务部门可能面临的潜在逆风因素。

CFO Hood stated, "Growth in Windows OEM and Devices will be impacted by lower PC market demand as higher component cost increased device pricing," highlighting potential headwinds for the More Personal Computing segment in the coming fiscal year.

pairs.en: Management reported total annual revenue exceeding $331 billion for the fiscal year, with growth driven by Azure and first-party AI applications. The company is transitioning its business model toward a per-seat plus consumption framework to broaden its addressable market. Nadella indicated that the architectural design focuses on model substitution and enterprise data control. Hood noted that capital expenditures are shifting toward short-lived assets like CPUs and GPUs to meet immediate demand while maintaining flexibility. The company also extended the estimated useful life of its data centers and office buildings to 25 years.
pairs.zh:
管理层报告本财年总营收超过$331 billion（约3,310亿美元），增长由Azure和第一方AI应用驱动。公司正将其商业模式转向"按席位+按用量"框架，以拓宽其可触达市场。Nadella表示，架构设计专注于模型替换和企业数据控制。Hood指出，资本支出正转向CPU和GPU等短期资产，以在保持灵活性的同时满足即时需求。公司还将其数据中心和办公建筑的预计使用年限延长至25年。

---

Management reported total annual revenue exceeding $331 billion for the fiscal year, with growth driven by Azure and first-party AI applications. The company is transitioning its business model toward a per-seat plus consumption framework to broaden its addressable market. Nadella indicated that the architectural design focuses on model substitution and enterprise data control. Hood noted that capital expenditures are shifting toward short-lived assets like CPUs and GPUs to meet immediate demand while maintaining flexibility. The company also extended the estimated useful life of its data centers and office buildings to 25 years.

pairs.en: CEO Nadella attributed sales growth in Copilot to "record usage intensity," with average weekly engagement now comparable to Outlook and Teams.
pairs.zh:
CEO Nadella 将 Copilot 的销售增长归因于"创纪录的使用强度"，目前其平均每周参与度已可与 Outlook 和 Teams 相媲美。

CEO Nadella attributed sales growth in Copilot to "record usage intensity," with average weekly engagement now comparable to Outlook and Teams.

pairs.en: The company launched Microsoft Frontier Co., an engineering organization with 6,000 experts focused on co-designing AI systems with enterprise customers.
pairs.zh:
公司推出了 Microsoft Frontier Co.，一个由 6,000 名专家组成的工程组织，专注于与企业客户共同设计 AI 系统。

The company launched Microsoft Frontier Co., an engineering organization with 6,000 experts focused on co-designing AI systems with enterprise customers.

pairs.en: Management announced a partnership with Mistral to bring models to the Microsoft Sovereign Cloud, targeting customers with high data compliance requirements.
pairs.zh:
管理层宣布与Mistral建立合作伙伴关系，将模型引入Microsoft Sovereign Cloud，目标客户为具有高数据合规要求的客户。

Management announced a partnership with Mistral to bring models to the Microsoft Sovereign Cloud, targeting customers with high data compliance requirements.

pairs.en: CEO Nadella noted that 1 in 3 pull requests on GitHub now involve an agent, signaling a shift toward agentic software development.
pairs.zh:
CEO Nadella（首席执行官）表示，GitHub上目前每3个拉取请求（pull request）中就有1个涉及智能体（agent），标志着软件开发正向智能体化（agentic）方向转变。

CEO Nadella noted that 1 in 3 pull requests on GitHub now involve an agent, signaling a shift toward agentic software development.

pairs.en: CFO Hood stated, "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity," noting that efficiency gains in the CPU and GPU fleet are being quickly monetized.
pairs.zh:
CFO Hood（首席财务官）表示："客户需求持续超过现有产能，"他指出，CPU和GPU集群的效率提升正在被快速变现。

CFO Hood stated, "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity," noting that efficiency gains in the CPU and GPU fleet are being quickly monetized.

pairs.en: The company expects Xbox to return to growth in fiscal year 2027 following operational decisions to reset the content portfolio.
pairs.zh:
公司预计Xbox将在2027财年恢复增长，此前公司已通过运营决策对内容组合进行了重置。

The company expects Xbox to return to growth in fiscal year 2027 following operational decisions to reset the content portfolio.

pairs.en: INDUSTRY GLOSSARY
pairs.zh:
行业术语表

INDUSTRY GLOSSARY

pairs.en: RPO: Remaining Performance Obligation represents the total value of contracted revenue that has not yet been recognized.
pairs.zh:
RPO：剩余履约义务代表尚未确认的已签约营收的总价值。

RPO: Remaining Performance Obligation represents the total value of contracted revenue that has not yet been recognized.

pairs.en: ARPU: Average Revenue Per User measures the revenue generated per subscriber or seat.
pairs.zh:
ARPU：每用户平均收入，衡量每个订阅用户或席位所产生的营收。

ARPU: Average Revenue Per User measures the revenue generated per subscriber or seat.

pairs.en: TAC: Traffic Acquisition Costs are payments made to search partners for directed traffic.
pairs.zh:
TAC（流量获取成本）：是指向搜索合作伙伴支付的、用于获取定向流量的款项。

TAC: Traffic Acquisition Costs are payments made to search partners for directed traffic.

pairs.en: GPU: Graphics Processing Unit, a specialized processor used for parallel computing and AI workloads.
pairs.zh:
**翻译：**

GPU：图形处理器（Graphics Processing Unit），一种用于并行计算和AI工作负载的专用处理器。

**原文：**

GPU: Graphics Processing Unit, a specialized processor used for parallel computing and AI workloads.

pairs.en: CPU: Central Processing Unit, the primary processor of a computer or server.
pairs.zh:
CPU：中央处理器，计算机或服务器的主要处理器。

CPU: Central Processing Unit, the primary processor of a computer or server.

pairs.en: GAAP: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles are the standard framework of guidelines for financial accounting.
pairs.zh:
GAAP：公认会计准则是用于财务会计的标准框架性指南。
GAAP: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles are the standard framework of guidelines for financial accounting.

pairs.en: SKU: Stock Keeping Unit is a distinct type of item for sale, such as a specific software license tier.
pairs.zh:
SKU：库存单位（Stock Keeping Unit），是指可供销售的不同类型商品，例如特定的软件许可证层级。

SKU: Stock Keeping Unit is a distinct type of item for sale, such as a specific software license tier.

pairs.en: Maia 200: Microsoft's custom-designed AI accelerator silicon.
pairs.zh:
Maia 200：微软自主设计的AI加速器芯片。

Maia 200: Microsoft's custom-designed AI accelerator silicon.

pairs.en: Fabric: An end-to-end, unified analytics platform that brings together data and analytics tools.
pairs.zh:
Fabric：一个端到端的统一分析平台，整合数据与分析工具。

Fabric: An end-to-end, unified analytics platform that brings together data and analytics tools.

pairs.en: Foundry: An AI app and agent stack for building and managing intelligent agents.
pairs.zh:
**翻译：**
Foundry：一个用于构建和管理智能代理的 AI 应用与代理技术栈。

**原文：**
Foundry: An AI app and agent stack for building and managing intelligent agents.

pairs.en: Agent 365: A control plane for governing, managing, and securing AI agents.
pairs.zh:
Agent 365：一个用于治理、管理和保护 AI 智能体的控制平面。

Agent 365: A control plane for governing, managing, and securing AI agents.

pairs.en: PostgreSQL: An open-source relational database used for storing and retrieving AI context.
pairs.zh:
PostgreSQL：一个用于存储和检索AI上下文数据的开源关系型数据库。

PostgreSQL: An open-source relational database used for storing and retrieving AI context.

pairs.en: Constant Currency: A financial calculation that eliminates the effects of foreign exchange rate fluctuations.
pairs.zh:
固定汇率：一种消除外汇汇率波动影响的财务计算方法。

Constant Currency: A financial calculation that eliminates the effects of foreign exchange rate fluctuations.

pairs.en: E7: A premium Microsoft 365 licensing suite that includes advanced security and AI management tools.
pairs.zh:
E7：一套高级版Microsoft 365许可套件，包含高级安全与AI管理工具。

E7: A premium Microsoft 365 licensing suite that includes advanced security and AI management tools.

pairs.en: MAI: A family of proprietary AI models developed by Microsoft, including versions optimized for code and security.
pairs.zh:
MAI：微软开发的专有AI模型系列，包括针对代码和安全进行优化的版本。

MAI: A family of proprietary AI models developed by Microsoft, including versions optimized for code and security.

pairs.en: We added 31 new data centers across 5 continents this quarter, bringing the total to 88 this year as we expand our footprint in response to accelerating demand. pairs.en: AI sovereignty is increasingly top of mind for our customers, and we are expanding our offerings to meet that need. Just last week, we announced a partnership with Mistral to bring its models to Microsoft Sovereign Cloud, enabling customers to run them across public, customer-controlled, and fully disconnected environments. We also continue to modernize our fleet with our own silicon innovation alongside the latest from NVIDIA and AMD. Maia 200 continues to scale. It delivers 30% better performance per dollar than the latest generation hardware in our fleet and is now supporting both OpenAI and MAI models. And we will be among the first cloud providers to deploy next-generation rack-scale AI infrastructure based on AMD Helios and NVIDIA Vera Rubin.
pairs.zh:
AI主权日益成为我们客户关注的首要议题，我们正在扩展我们的产品组合以满足这一需求。就在上周，我们宣布与Mistral建立合作伙伴关系，将其模型引入Microsoft Sovereign Cloud，使客户能够在公有云、客户控制环境以及完全隔离的环境中运行这些模型。我们还在通过自研芯片创新以及来自NVIDIA和AMD的最新产品，持续对我们的服务器集群进行现代化升级。Maia 200持续扩展部署。与我们服务器集群中上一代硬件相比，它实现了每美元30%的性能提升，目前正在同时支持OpenAI和MAI模型。我们也将成为首批部署基于AMD Helios和NVIDIA Vera Rubin的下一代机架级AI基础设施的云服务提供商之一。

AI sovereignty is increasingly top of mind for our customers, and we are expanding our offerings to meet that need. We also continue to modernize our fleet with our own silicon innovation alongside the latest from NVIDIA and AMD. Maia 200 continues to scale. And we will be among the first cloud providers to deploy next-generation rack-scale AI infrastructure based on AMD Helios and NVIDIA Vera Rubin.

pairs.en: When it comes to running agents, CPUs are just as important as GPUs. Our Cobalt VMs are powering both our own first-party workloads as well as workloads for customers, including Adobe, Arm, Elastic, OpenAI, Sprinklr, and TomTom. And by the end of this month, we expect to have our Cobalt 200 racks in over 25 data centers around the world as we rapidly expand capacity. Now let me turn to the end-to-end platform we are building on this infrastructure to run, govern, and distribute apps and agents. It starts with model choice. Every customer wants the right model for each task based on quality, latency, cost, and compliance.
pairs.zh:
在运行智能体时，CPU 与 GPU 同样重要。我们的 Cobalt 虚拟机不仅为我们的第一方工作负载提供算力，也为包括 Adobe、Arm、Elastic、OpenAI、Sprinklr 和 TomTom 在内的客户工作负载提供支持。预计到本月底，我们的 Cobalt 200 机架将部署在全球超过 25 个数据中心，我们将持续快速扩张算力。接下来，请允许我将话题转向我们构建在这套基础设施之上的端到端平台，用于运行、管理和分发应用与智能体。该平台首先从模型选择开始。每位客户都希望根据质量、延迟、成本和合规性，为每项任务选择最合适的模型。

pairs.en: We offer the broadest model catalog in the cloud with over 11,000 models, including the latest from OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, xAI, as well as our own MAI family. Since the start of the year, we have seen 5x increase in the number of customers building with models from multiple providers. Levi Strauss & Co., for example, is using models from OpenAI and Anthropic on Foundry as it brings more than 1,000 domain-specific agents into a unified enterprise AI platform. We are also accelerating our own model development. We announced more than a dozen new models across image, voice, transcription, coding, security, including our first reasoning model MAI-Thinking-1, all with cost-efficient inference at the core for the enterprise use cases.
pairs.zh:
我们在云端提供最广泛的模型目录，拥有超过 11,000 个模型，包括来自 OpenAI、Anthropic、Mistral、xAI 的最新模型，以及我们自有的 MAI 系列。自年初以来，我们看到使用多个供应商模型进行构建的客户数量增长了 5 倍。例如，Levi Strauss & Co. 正在 Foundry 上使用 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的模型，将超过 1,000 个领域特定的智能体整合到一个统一的企业 AI 平台中。我们也在加速自有模型的开发。我们宣布了超过一打的全新模型，覆盖图像、语音、转录、编码、安全等领域，包括我们的首个推理模型 MAI-Thinking-1，所有这些模型均以面向企业用例的高性价比推理为核心。

pairs.en: We are co-designing these models with our silicon, and we are seeing 40% better performance per watt when running MAI models on Maia 200. But more importantly, we are building a new model system where the harness, context, memory, and action space are separate from any one model family, thereby moving the frontier on the cost-to-outcome curve. And it's not just about cost. It also has the added benefit of business continuity and resilience because every model is substitutable. This is the system we are using in our products with great results.
pairs.zh:
我们正在与我们的芯片协同设计这些模型，在Maia 200上运行MAI模型时，我们看到每瓦性能提升40%。但更重要的是，我们正在构建一个新的模型系统，其中编排框架、上下文、记忆和动作空间与任何一个模型家族都是分离的，从而在成本与效果曲线上推进前沿。而且这不仅仅是关乎成本——它还带来了业务连续性和韧性的额外优势，因为每个模型都是可替换的。这正是我们在产品中使用的系统，并取得了出色的效果。

---

We are co-designing these models with our silicon, and we are seeing 40% better performance per watt when running MAI models on Maia 200. But more importantly, we are building a new model system where the harness, context, memory, and action space are separate from any one model family, thereby moving the frontier on the cost-to-outcome curve. And it's not just about cost. It also has the added benefit of business continuity and resilience because every model is substitutable. This is the system we are using in our products with great results.

pairs.en: For example, millions of developers have used MAI-Code-1-Flash on GitHub Copilot achieving higher code acceptance rates and 10% lower median token usage, while still having access to frontier capabilities from OpenAI and Anthropic. In Excel, MAI-Code-1-Flash is delivering comparable quality to GPT-5.6 for the most common task while operating at significantly lower costs. In security, MAI-Cyber-1-Flash achieves better performance than much larger Mythos model but at half the cost when combined with our multiagent security harness. More broadly, across our model implementations, we are seeing significant efficiency gains, including 89% reduction of GPU costs in Dynamics 365 with MAI-Voice-2-Flash and up to 84% reduced GPU costs in PowerPoint with MAI-Image-2.5.
pairs.zh:
例如，数百万开发者已在GitHub Copilot上使用MAI-Code-1-Flash，实现了更高的代码接受率以及中位token使用量降低10%，同时仍可使用来自OpenAI和Anthropic的前沿能力。在Excel中，MAI-Code-1-Flash在最常见的任务上所提供的质量与GPT-5.6相当，而运营成本却显著更低。在安全领域，MAI-Cyber-1-Flash在与我们多智能体安全框架（multiagent security harness）结合后，以一半的成本实现了比体积更大的Mythos模型更优的性能。更广泛地看，在我们各类模型的部署中，我们正取得显著的效率提升，其中包括：在Dynamics 365中借助MAI-Voice-2-Flash使GPU成本降低89%，以及在PowerPoint中借助MAI-Image-2.5使GPU成本降低高达84%。

pairs.zh:

pairs.zh:
本季度，我们将这些Copilot体验整合在一起，包括Code，整合为一个跨越消费级和商业级体验的超级应用。这是重大的一步，我期待很快分享更多内容。

更广泛地说，我们一直在稳步提升Copilot的质量和性能，并对近期客户反馈感到欣喜。过去3个季度，用户满意度评分翻了一番，目前达到历史新高。仅本季度，我们将延迟降低了25%。这些质量改进，加上持续的产品创新，正在推动使用强度创下纪录。每位用户的对话数量同比增长近一倍。平均每周参与度与Outlook和Teams持平。

And this quarter, we are bringing these Copilot experiences together, including Code, in one super app spanning both consumer and commercial experiences. This is a major step forward, and I look forward to sharing more soon. More broadly, we have steadily been improving the quality and performance of Copilot, and have been delighted by the recent customer feedback. Over the last 3 quarters, user satisfaction scores have doubled and are now at an all-time high. And this quarter alone, we cut latency by 25%. These quality improvements, together with continued product innovation, are driving record usage intensity. The number of conversations per user nearly doubled year-over-year. Average weekly engagement is on par with Outlook and Teams.

pairs.en: And the time from deployment to what we think of as high usage, meaning monthly active usage about 80% across a customers' user base, has fallen from months to just days over the past year. pairs.en: In addition to this, we are also evolving our business model beyond per seat to per seat plus consumption, further expanding our TAM and delivering more customer value. Earlier this month, we added usage-based billing to Cowork with thousands of customers already paying for and actively using it. In biz apps, we have been reinventing Dynamics 365 for an agent-first world. We are exposing over 650,000 MCP actions across sales, finance, supply chain, HR, and customer service so that agents can now access business context and take action using the same data models, rules, permission, security guardrails, and audit trails as any application user. And we are also moving from seats to seats plus consumption model.
pairs.zh:
此外，我们也在不断演进商业模式，从单一的"按席位"模式向"按席位+使用量"模式转变，进一步扩大我们的总可触达市场（TAM），并为客户创造更多价值。本月早些时候，我们在Cowork中新增了基于使用量的计费功能，已有数千名客户正在为此付费并积极使用。在业务应用方面，我们一直在为智能体优先的世界重新打造Dynamics 365。我们在销售、财务、供应链、人力资源和客户服务等领域开放了超过650,000个MCP actions，使智能体现在能够访问业务上下文，并使用与任何应用用户相同的数据模型、规则、权限、安全护栏和审计跟踪来采取行动。我们也在从席位模式转向"席位+使用量"模式。

pairs.en: Every major coding agent runs on the platform and 1 in 3 pull requests on GitHub now involves an agent. pairs.zh:

pairs.en: In health care, we are on pace to automate over 100 million patient encounters this calendar year, including 28 million this quarter, up 2x year-over-year. pairs.en: And therefore, there is a tremendous opportunity to turn customers' workflows, domain knowledge, and accumulated judgment into AI systems that learn and improve with every usage. pairs.zh:

pairs.en: Amy Hood:Thank you, Satya, and good afternoon, everyone. This fiscal year, we delivered over $331 billion in revenue, with growth accelerating to 18%, driven by strong demand across both the Azure platform and our first-party AI applications and services. Operating income growth outpaced revenue growth, increasing 21% to more than $155 billion as we invested in long-term growth while continuing to expand operating leverage. This quarter, revenue was $90 billion, up 18% and 17% in constant currency. Gross margin dollars increased 15% and operating income increased 18%. Earnings per share was $4.74, an increase of 23% when adjusted for the impact from our investment in OpenAI. And FX was roughly in line with guidance.
pairs.zh:
Amy Hood：谢谢 Satya，大家下午好。本财年，我们实现营收超过 $331 billion，同比增长加速至 18%，这主要得益于 Azure 平台以及我们第一方 AI 应用和服务的强劲需求。营业利润增长超过营收增长，增幅达 21%，达到 $155 billion 以上，这是因为我们在持续扩大经营杠杆的同时，也投资于长期增长。本季度，营收为 $90 billion，按报告口径增长 18%，按固定汇率计算增长 17%。毛利金额增长 15%，营业利润增长 18%。每股收益为 $4.74，调整对 OpenAI 投资的影响后增长 23%。外汇与指引基本一致。

原文：
Amy Hood:Thank you, Satya, and good afternoon, everyone. This fiscal year, we delivered over $331 billion in revenue, with growth accelerating to 18%, driven by strong demand across both the Azure platform and our first-party AI applications and services. Operating income growth outpaced revenue growth, increasing 21% to more than $155 billion as we invested in long-term growth while continuing to expand operating leverage. This quarter, revenue was $90 billion, up 18% and 17% in constant currency. Gross margin dollars increased 15% and operating income increased 18%. Earnings per share was $4.74, an increase of 23% when adjusted for the impact from our investment in OpenAI. And FX was roughly in line with guidance.

pairs.en: Several discrete items impacted our financial results in the quarter when compared to our forward-looking guidance provided on our April earnings call, resulting in a benefit of $0.27 on diluted earnings per share. These included a $3.2 billion gain from our investment in Anthropic and lower-than-expected expenses related to the Voluntary Retirement Program, which were partially offset by severance expense and impairment charges in Xbox. When adjusting for these items, we exceeded expectations across revenue, operating income, and earnings per share due to strong demand and execution in the quarter.
pairs.zh:
与我们在4月财报电话会议上提供的前瞻性指引相比，几项离散项目对本季度的财务业绩产生了影响，使摊薄每股收益获得0.27美元的收益。这些项目包括我们对Anthropic投资带来的32亿美元收益，以及与自愿退休计划相关的低于预期的费用，但部分被Xbox的遣散费及减值费用所抵消。在剔除这些项目后，由于本季度强劲的需求和执行力，我们在营收、营业利润和每股收益方面均超出预期。

Several discrete items impacted our financial results in the quarter when compared to our forward-looking guidance provided on our April earnings call, resulting in a benefit of $0.27 on diluted earnings per share. These included a $3.2 billion gain from our investment in Anthropic and lower-than-expected expenses related to the Voluntary Retirement Program, which were partially offset by severance expense and impairment charges in Xbox. When adjusting for these items, we exceeded expectations across revenue, operating income, and earnings per share due to strong demand and execution in the quarter.

pairs.en: Company gross margin percentage was 67%, down year-over-year, driven by sales mix shift to Azure as well as continued investments in AI infrastructure and growing product usage, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains, particularly in Azure and M365 Commercial cloud. Operating expenses increased 10%, driven by continued investment in R&D compute capacity, talent, and data to support product development across the portfolio. G&A growth was impacted by a low prior-year comparable as well as some of the discrete items mentioned earlier. Operating margins increased slightly year-over-year to 45%. Total company head count declined 2% year-over-year.
pairs.zh:

Operating expenses increased 10%, driven by continued investment in R&D compute capacity, talent, and data to support product development across the portfolio. pairs.en: When adjusted for the impact of our investments in OpenAI, other income and expense was $2.8 billion, driven by the gain on investment in Anthropic noted earlier. Capital expenditures were $41 billion, including the impact from higher component pricing, as noted in our guide. Roughly 2/3 of our CapEx was for short-lived assets, primarily CPUs and GPUs as customers increasingly build solutions that leverage both AI and non-AI infrastructure. When the harness will ensure that your memory, your context, all of that is external. That means any given model at any given time is swappable. You should and you can use frontier models. pairs.en: That's really the enterprise design architecture that we are going to evangelize. We ourselves are using it. Copilot is built that way. GitHub Copilot is built that way. So for example, your CRM system, your ERP system, all of them are just skills and plug-ins that go into Cowork.

The usage intensity itself has gone up significantly. I mean we are talking about usage intensity that's sort of at the same level of what is an everyday communication tool like Outlook or Teams. The second thing I would say is the overall enterprise wiring of this, right? So it's not like a tool that's isolated somewhere, but it's wired in, whether it is you brought up E7, right? So it's wired into the governance pieces with Agent 365, so then you have your IT ops, SecOps, FinOps, all wired in as well as it's all the business processes. Brad Zelnick: Satya, appreciating cybersecurity is so core to everything Microsoft does. The playing field shifted recently with the latest frontier model releases. And this week, you introduced Project Perception. Can you expand on what this moment means for your cyber business explicitly? And also what it means for trust in Microsoft more broadly?

pairs.en: Satya Nadella:Yes. Thank you for that question. I think you're right about saying that the entire, I would say, the overall physics of how both what is needed in terms of the cyber product and even the cyber operations because at the end of the day, you kind of have to sort of transform yourself on both the products, but also how you operate as a company to protect yourself have changed pretty dramatically. So what we are focused on is, first, again, take the same approach we have taken for knowledge work or coding, which is you've got to start with an intelligence-first, model-forward approach.
pairs.zh:
Satya Nadella：好的，谢谢你的提问。我认为你说得很对，整体而言，可以说是整个"物理学"——无论是从网络安全产品所需的角度，还是从网络安全运营的角度——都已经发生了相当大的变化，因为归根结底，无论是在产品层面，还是在作为一家公司如何运营以保护自身的层面，你都需要进行自我转型。所以我们首先关注的，是采用与我们在知识工作或编程领域相同的做法，即必须从智能优先、模型驱动的方法入手。

So what we are focused on is, first, again, take the same approach we have taken for knowledge work or coding, which is you've got to start with an intelligence-first, model-forward approach.

pairs.en: And so what we launched with Perception is essentially saying, let's sort of really make sure that you have the red team agents that know how to find -- constantly are red teaming and finding the vulnerabilities. pairs.en: And the reason is because 90% of the tasks are done by the Cyber-1-Flash model, and 10% of the tasks, you still go to the frontier, right? pairs.en: So it's cost and resilience is both an important criteria. And that's what we are trying to build in, whether it's in code, whether it's in cyber, whether it is in knowledge work. pairs.zh:
因此，成本和韧性都是重要的标准。这也是我们正努力打造的——无论是在代码领域、网络安全领域，还是在知识工作领域。坦白说，我们对 Perception 及其对未来安全业务的意义感到非常兴奋。
